_about: What can go into a BASTION kit. Each item is fetched from its OFFICIAL source by tools/kit-build.ps1 and checked against the SHA-256 below before it is used. An item with an empty url or sha256 is 'not pinned yet': the builder will not download it, but accepts a file you place in the kit folder yourself (and prints its SHA-256 so it can be pinned). Pin a new version only after testing it together with the others.
